# @ewo (vendored)

Generated by Folio (`npm run vendor`, folio cc67ca5). Don't edit these files here: change them in Folio and vendor again.

- `tokens/tokens.css`: the shared custom properties (`--ewo-*`), in `@layer ewo`. Import it first (before `@import "tailwindcss"` too); the project then sets the ones it differs in, and anything it declares wins over the layer.
- `tokens/projects.css`: each project's colour (`--ewo-project-<name>`), and `data-ewo-project` to make one the accent.
- `tokens/bundle.css`: both of the above in one file, for a page without a build step.
- `tokens/fonts.css`, `tokens/index.css`, `tokens/fonts/`: only in projects that take the fonts from here.
- `elements/<name>.js`: one custom element per module (`<ewo-switch>`, `<ewo-segmented>`, …). Import only the ones used; each defines itself once.
- `elements/theme-shift.js`: `themeShift(apply)`, a theme change under a short blur of the page (no element).
- `elements/scroll-lock.js`: `lockScroll()`, the page stops scrolling until the function it returns is called; `<ewo-sheet>` takes it while open, an app's own `<dialog>` can too (no element).
- `elements/press.js`: `pressFeedback({ preset })`, a visible answer to every tap on a phone (`data-pressed`, calm or lively); call it once in main.ts (no element).
- `elements/waiting.js`: `track(control, (signal) => action, { label })`, the wait after a tap at the control that started it: held pressed until the answer, the working mark at 150 ms, words at 1.2 s, `Taking longer` at 6 s, `Try again` at 12 s; `configureWaiting({ mark })` for a game's own mark (`plans/waiting-states.md` in the workspace).
- `elements/connection.js`: `<ewo-connection state>`, the room's connection in a pill when it's worth saying (connecting after 400 ms, reconnecting after 1.5 s, then `Connected again`).
- `elements/emblem.js` and `elements/emblem-maker.js`: players' emblems (`<ewo-emblem theme value>`, `<ewo-emblem-maker>`), themes `heraldry` (Vollmond's shield), `doodle` (Kritzle's face), `tag` (Schätzle's price tag), `agent` (CDNMS's agent) and `token`. `elements/emblem-core.js` has no DOM: an app's server imports it to check what a player sent (`cleanEmblem(theme, value)`). `elements/emblem-shared.js`: one avatar and name in every game, in a cookie on ewolution.cloud: `playerEmblem(theme, own)` to load, `shareEmblem(theme, value)` when the player picks one, `sharedName()` / `shareName(name)`. `plans/emblems.md` in the workspace.
- `elements/guide.js`: `<ewo-guide>`, a how-to as full-screen pages (swipe, the dots, Back and Next, Done), each child one page drawn by the app; `firstVisit(key)` says whether to open it on its own (once per device). `elements/modal-focus.js` is the focus handling it shares with `<ewo-sheet>`.
- `elements/slot-reel.js`: `<ewo-slot-reel>`, a slot machine's reel: the app renders the strip as its children and `await reel.spin()` pulls back, runs (blurred at speed), overshoots, settles and shines; `tick` per row and `land` events, `rows="3"` shows the neighbours, `tease` for a near miss. `elements/reel-strip.js` has no DOM: `reelPick` (never the same twice), `reelStrip` (the rows to run through) and `reelMotion` (the curve).
- `elements/slider.js`: `<ewo-slider min max step value>`, a range slider that drags smoothly (the knob follows the pointer and leans towards the nearest step; only transforms move), glides onto its step on release; `mark` (e.g. the default), `ticks`, `ends`, `unit`, a value bubble; `input` per step while dragging, `change` on release; role=slider with the keys. `elements/slider-scale.js` has no DOM: `snap`, `valueAt`, `fractionOf`.
- `elements/card-tilt.js`, `card-fan.js`, `card-hand.js`, `card-pile.js`, `card-paper.js`: the card kit for the family's card games (no elements, no deck art): `tilt(node)` and `askTilt()` (gyro, finger or mouse; a `.glare` and the deck's `.foil` gradients), `fanLayout(keys, { width })` with `fanTransform`, `cardAt` and `flightTransform` (the hand in one or two rows), `handGestures(box, …)` (scrub, drag or flick to play, tap twice, refuse, hold to look, a select mode), `seatAngle`, `trickSlot`, `sweepTo`, `cardTwist`, `stackPlace` (the table's geometry) and `paperGrain()` (the `--grain` texture). Stichle's `Hand`, `Trick` and `Card` show them in use.
- `elements/settings-button.js` and `elements/settings-basics.js`: the settings button (the sliders icon) and the Language and Theme rows every app's settings begin with (`plans/settings-alignment.md` in the workspace).
- `elements/react.d.ts`, `elements/svelte.d.ts`: JSX and Svelte typings for the elements.
- `elements/custom-elements.json`: the elements' API, for editors and tooling.
